result.brief: 提出PROWBench基准，用程序化构建的可回放世界记录评测视频模型对程序指定事件、实体控制与长时序记忆的渲染保真度。
result.reason: Benchmark for programmable world models evaluating video generation fidelity to program-specified events, entity control, and long-horizon memory—directly serving video world models and video generation evaluation.
